functions.name: DaxLib.SVG.Element.UseDef
functions.description: Reference a previously defined SVG element with optional positioning and styling This function is used to reuse elements that have been defined using `DaxLib.SVG.Def.*` functions (e.g., `DaxLib.SVG.Def.Circle`, `DaxLib.SVG.Def.Rect`, `DaxLib.SVG.Def.Paths`, etc.).
